usedFor: Google Calendar holds your meetings, and Teamwork receives follow-up work when “New or Updated Event” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Event” in Google Calendar, then “Create Task” in Teamwork
bestTemplate.why: Each scheduled event gets a Teamwork task, so preparation does not live only on the calendar.

watchOut: “New or Updated Event” fires on edits as well, so a moved meeting can create a second task.
